composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# A create carrying an already-seen 'Idempotency-Key' replays the originally created owner (200)
# rather than running the create pipeline again (which would reject the repeat as a duplicate).
idempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  outputs:
    replay: replayLoad
    fresh: validate

replayLoad:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.LoadOwnerById
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]
  next: replayRespond

replayRespond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwner
  govern: [ readonly-transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwnerFields
  next: registrationDate

registrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveRegistrationDate
  next: cityCapacity

cityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: dailyLimit

dailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: household-assign

household-assign:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: identity

identity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckUniqueIdentity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: possibleDuplicate

possibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: customerCode

customerCode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignCustomerCode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: membershipNumber

membershipNumber:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipNumber
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: namesakes

namesakes:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CountNamesakes
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: bulkSignup

bulkSignup:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: record

record:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

The spec: a new owner's `membershipLevel` cannot exceed one above the current maximum `membershipLevel` among their existing household members; with no existing household member, no cap applies.
